title: Cheeni Kum
desc: Buddhadev, a 64-year-old chef, falls for Nina, 34. Their future is shaken when he learns her father is six years younger than him, casting doubt on their relationship.

title: John Jani Janardhan
desc: After John is killed, his wife gives birth to twin sons and dies. Twins Jani and Janardhan are pitted against one another by a wily gangster.

title: God Tussi Great Ho
desc: Arun blames God for his troubles, but when God appears and grants him divine powers, Arun tries to make the world better by fulfilling everyone's wishes.

title: Gully Boy
desc: Murad, an underdog from Dharavi, struggles to express his reality and social issues through rap, until meeting local rapper MC Sher, whose guidance transforms his confidence and dreams.

title: Bawaal
desc: A small-town boy falls in love with the most beautiful girl in town. He eventually gets married to her only because he realises that their marriage can help him climb the social ladder.

title: Gadar-Ek Prem Katha
desc: During the partition, Tara marries Sakina, living happily together. Their joy ends when Sakina's father forces her to remain in Pakistan, separating her from Tara and her family forever.

title: Race
desc: Two stepbrothers run a lavish stud farm and horse racing empire. When they fall for the same woman, jealousy turns deadly-one plots murder to claim love and insurance money.

title: Raksha Bandhan
desc: The eldest brother of four sisters, a humble chaat seller, struggles to honor his ailing mother's wish while steadfastly protecting their family's values and dignity.

title: Shirdi Ke Sai Baba
desc: A doctor visits Shirdi with his ailing son, torn between faith and science. To save his child, he must decide if Sai Baba's blessings hold the cure he desperately seeks.

title: Himmatwala (1983)
desc: Ravi, an engineer, promises to restore his father's lost reputation. Meanwhile, the daughter of his enemy, Sher Singh, falls in love with him and helps him trick her father.

title: Rustom
desc: Rustom is a navy officer happily married to Cynthia. When he finds out she's cheating with his friend Vikram, things turn tragic, and Rustom is blamed for murder.

title: Dhadak
desc: Madhu and Parthavi fall in love despite social differences. Families oppose them, forcing the couple to elope, while her father and brother chase relentlessly, testing their bond.

title: Dream Girl
desc: Karamveer lands a call-center job thanks to his knack for mimicking a woman's voice. Fame follows, but trouble brews as obsessed clients push him into dangerous territory.

title: Baazigar
desc: Ajay Sharma seduces and kills a businessman's daughter, staging it as a suicide. He then plots to destroy the entire family, driven by a cold vendetta.

title: Dunki
desc: A group of friends risk everything to reach the UK through a dangerous route called 'donkey flight', facing life-threatening challenges and the harsh reality of illegal immigration.

title: Ghoomer
desc: Anina, a young cricket star, loses her right hand before her debut. With help from a failed cricketer and creative training, she becomes a bowler and invents a new style.
